description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of 'git pack-redundant'. It contains setup, test cases, and utility functions to create repositories, packs, and simulate various scenarios of pack redundancy detection in git repositories.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates a series of commits in a given git repository, outputs commit OIDs.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in the given repository with objects specified via stdin and assigns its ID to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats pack filenames from input, sorts, and outputs unique pack identifiers.
